run.target: Core reliable integration runtime and versioned public envelope contract

groups.title: Versioned envelope and external fixture compatibility

rows.action: Validate the versioned envelope and stable event type contract
rows.assertion: Required identity fields are validated and the returned payload cannot be mutated

rows.action: Load the exact T04 release-v2 fixture with JSON null and take a deep immutable payload snapshot
rows.assertion: SHA-256 and JSON tree equal the T04 head fixture; null survives; caller and nested mutations cannot alter the envelope

rows.action: Commit source fact and outbox atomically, and roll both back on source failure
rows.assertion: Source and outbox rows commit together and both are absent after injected rollback

rows.action: Reject enqueue without an active source transaction
rows.assertion: The accessor throws and persists zero outbox rows without a business transaction

rows.action: Recover an expired claim after crash/restart
rows.assertion: Reconcile recovers one expired lease and the consumer projection is eventually applied

rows.action: Suppress duplicate delivery with one durable consumer receipt
rows.assertion: A duplicate dispatch leaves exactly one projection row and one receipt

rows.action: Fence out-of-order events by tenant, ordering key, and sequence
rows.assertion: Persisted consumer apply order is sequence 1 followed by sequence 2

rows.action: Move a poison event to a durable dead letter after bounded retries
rows.assertion: The outbox is failed and exactly one open DLQ row exists

rows.action: Reject a stale worker completion after lease takeover
rows.assertion: Completion with the abandoned token returns false after lease takeover

rows.action: Replay a dead letter with attribution and reconcile expired leases
rows.assertion: Replay attribution, delivered state, replayed DLQ status, and recovery count are persisted

rows.action: Expose low-cardinality outcome counters and health alerts
rows.assertion: Outcome counters increase and health transitions DOWN for poison state then UP after replay

groups.title: Cross-lane composition still outside this branch

rows.action: Run the real Procurement producer through the real Inventory receipt command adapter
rows.assertion: Real Procurement and Inventory business records plus the runtime receipt

rows.action: Validate the real T05 Quality Hold consumer against the hash-pinned T04 contract
rows.assertion: Real quality-hold business effect and runtime receipt commit together

rows.action: Re-run the contract and lifecycle suite on the exact ten-lane integration composition
rows.assertion: Exact composition OIDs and the real-stack suite are recorded by T10

residualGaps: The Core PostgreSQL pilot uses a test consumer fixture; the real T02 Procurement producer and Inventory command adapter are not present on this branch.
The T04 exact fixture is contract-tested, but the real T05 Quality Hold consumer was not composed here.
T10 must regenerate the schema snapshot and rerun these gates on the exact composed heads.
